'''November 2003 Pittsburgh tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament held on 29 November 2003 at Helm's Deep Games in Dormont, near Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, organized by [[Dan Tartaglione]].<ref name="pcf-2381-36533">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=36533#36533 Tournaments In Pittsburgh], Dan Tartaglione, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 November 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040106234534/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=38056%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The players were Reid, Patrick Johnson, the Hoy brothers and Tartaglione.<ref name="pcf-2381-38056">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=38056#38056 Tournaments In Pittsburgh], Dan Tartaglione, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 December 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040106234534/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=38056%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Helm's Deep Games, Dormont, Pennsylvania<ref name="pcf-2381-36533" />
* '''Dates:''' 29 November 2003<ref name="pcf-2381-36533" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Dan Tartaglione]]<ref name="pcf-2381-36533" />
* '''Entry fee:''' between $5 and $10<ref name="pcf-2381-36533" />

Prizes were to be [[Special Edition]] or [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] product.<ref name="pcf-2381-36533" />
